jobs.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing artists, songwriters, producers, and creators. Across our business, we are building the next generation of music commerce, fan engagement, and direct-to-consumer experiences globally.

The Role

Sony Music is seeking a VP, D2C Creative, Product and Campaign Strategy to join the global Sony Music D2C organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Sony Music D2C, this role will lead the D2C Creative, Product and Campaign Strategy team within The Greenhouse, Sony Music’s centralized D2C division.

The purpose of this team is to make D2C marketing a constant, evergreen discipline for labels that today focus their effort on the release cycle. It is a central, cross-label team that acts as an extension of label digital marketing and international market execution — providing D2C expertise, filling execution capacity gaps, and building the frameworks that let others work well — while leaving artist narrative and campaign strategy with the label.

This is deliberately a small centre rather than a large production function. Labels resource their own D2C people for their own repertoire; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that unlock the value those teams create. Where a label does not yet have that capability, the team carries more of the work early and steps back as the label staffs up. There is no embedded headcount — the team operates as a shared service across labels and territories.

The VP is accountable for the quality and commercial performance of D2C creative, product and campaign activity across the roster, and for the relationships that make it work: with label marketing, creative and commerce teams, with the international marketing team, and with partners across The Greenhouse. Much of the work is proposing rather than deciding — the label approves throughout — which makes credibility, judgement and influence without authority central to the role.

The role leads a team of five to six, organised around three pillars: creative, covering design systems, production and D2C visual standards; product, covering D2C product management, pricing and lifecycle; and campaign, covering CRM, fan acquisition and marketing operations. The ideal candidate combines strong D2C product instincts, fan marketing expertise, creative sensibility and operational rigour, with a deep understanding of how fans engage with artists, music, merchandise and culture across global markets.

How This Team Operates

  • A small centre, not a production house. Labels resource their own D2C people; this team supplies the toolkit, standards and process that let them create value.
  • Proposes rather than decides. Recommendations are put to the label for approval. The team holds no authority independent of the label, and labels retain final say on every D2C decision.
  • Reuses and refines rather than originates. Artist narrative and campaign concept sit with the label. The team adapts existing creative for D2C — merchandise creative is the one area where it originates.

 The Manager, Sports Content Marketing & Partnerships will lead the development and execution of strategic marketing materials and initiatives that elevate SiriusXM's sports portfolio, drive audience engagement, strengthen league, team and talent partnerships, and support key business objectives. This role will help shape the marketing strategy across SiriusXM's sports properties while driving cross-functional alignment and operational excellence. This position requires an efficient, well-organized strategic marketer, relationship builder, and strong communicator with experience managing high-profile partnerships, developing compelling narratives, influencing stakeholders, and bringing integrated marketing campaigns to life.  Develop integrated marketing strategies for key sports programming initiatives, tentpole events, channel launches, original content, and partnership opportunities.

 Lead partner and talent marketing relationships across assigned sports properties, serving as the primary point of contact for leagues, teams, media partners, talent representatives, agencies, and other key stakeholders.

 Create presentations, strategic recommendations, and marketing narratives that clearly communicate objectives, opportunities, results, and business impact.

 Identify and champion innovative marketing opportunities that elevate SiriusXM's sports brands, deepen fan engagement, and create value for partners and stakeholders.
 Support marketing strategy and partnership activation efforts across current sports properties and emerging strategic partnerships.
 Analyze campaign, audience, and engagement performance to identify insights, inform future strategy, and communicate recommendations to leadership.
 Define and track success measures for assigned initiatives, including listening, engagement, audience growth, subscriber value, partner satisfaction, and campaign performance.
 Stay ahead of industry trends across sports, media, audio, streaming, social platforms, and fan engagement to identify opportunities that strengthen SiriusXM's competitive position.
 Serve as a trusted representative of the Sports Marketing & Partnerships team in meetings with external partners and internal cross-functional stakeholders.
 Track fulfillment of contractual marketing obligations across partnerships and ensure successful execution against agreed-upon commitments.

 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling narratives and present recommendations to executive audiences.
 Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business objectives into actionable marketing plans.

 Experience developing presentations, marketing strategies, business cases, and performance recaps.
 Experience reviewing partnership agreements, sponsorship contracts, talent agreements, or media rights deals with a strong understanding of marketing rights and obligations.
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
 Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Adobe Acrobat, Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign is a plus.
 Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Airtable, Monday.com, Asana, Wrike, or similar platforms.
 Strong familiarity with SiriusXM's sports content and talent.
 Excellent time management and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and multi-task, and work under shifting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
 Fast learner with strong attention to detail; proactive, self-motivated, and resourceful.
 Both a proactive team player and independent worker.
